description: This file defines the ExecutionMemoryPool class in Apache Spark, managing memory sharing among tasks with policies for allocation, deallocation, and synchronization.

classes.name: ExecutionMemoryPool
classes.description: Manages a pool of execution memory shared among tasks, with policies for memory allocation, release, and task management.

methods.name: memoryUsed
methods.description: Returns total memory used by all tasks in the pool.

methods.name: getMemoryUsageForTask
methods.description: Returns memory usage in bytes for a specific task.

methods.name: acquireMemory
methods.description: Attempts to allocate memory for a task, possibly blocking until enough memory is available, with policies to ensure fair sharing.

methods.name: releaseMemory
methods.description: Releases a specified amount of memory for a task.

methods.name: releaseAllMemoryForTask
methods.description: Releases all memory held by a task and marks it as inactive.
